analyst_assessment.fanti_beta_measurements: Testable experimental lead; isotope source and quantitative linen age correction not established.
analyst_assessment.rucker_spatial_prediction: 2018/2020 model predicts strong location differences, including apparent future radiocarbon dates near elbows. Numerical map is version-specific.
analyst_assessment.author_accepts_negative_tests: Rucker 2019 explicitly says statistically significant negative isotope results are evidence against the hypothesis.
analyst_assessment.current_model_issue: 2026 manuscripts fit unknown positions to existing data; a frozen current prediction map and rejection criteria are needed before new tests.
analyst_assessment.isotope_background: Natural and anthropogenic backgrounds, composition and retention must be considered.
analyst_assessment.completed_independent_shroud_wide_valida: Not located in bounded search; proposals and laboratory analogues are not actual Shroud-wide verification.
